body:
Three frozen rails have now flaked the same way under a loaded full bar, one first-observation
each: test/gateway/render-ocap.test.ts (fixed via the T248 ceremony - the serve half moved to a
bill the host can meet), test/gateway/probation-frame.test.ts (2026-08-29, 'a quarantined
route's write lands in the pool's store': 500 for 200, 23/23 in isolation), and
test/federation/install-by-federation.test.ts (2026-08-29, same bar: 'the renderer could not
start' where a section was expected, green in isolation). The mechanism is designed and
documented: a POOL render charges worker SPAWN to the pool's declared clock (renderers.ts -
'the envelope is the pool's whole bill'), so any fixture serving through a pool under a tight
or default bill races host scheduling whenever the whole suite saturates the box.

This ticket owns the CLASS, not one file. Triage: enumerate every test that drives a pool
serveRoute (grep openQuarantine + serveRoute and channel-app blessings that render), measure
which bills they run under, and move each flaking fixture's SERVE half onto a bill the host can
meet - the T248 shape: widen the envelope by a delta inside the fixture, assert the widening
took, keep every assertion. Frozen files move by declared revision. Consider also whether the
fixtures should share one helper that declares the generous bill, so the next pool test is born
load-proof. Never widen an assertion or a product default for a test's sake.

Acceptance criteria:
- (a) The pool-render test inventory exists with each fixture's effective bill named. Verify:
  the table quoted in the closing PR.
- (b) Every fixture that has flaked serves under a host-sized bill with assertions unchanged,
  via declared revisions. Verify: the diffs of the closing PR.
- (c) A shared fixture helper exists and the touched tests use it. Verify: the helper's own
  test plus grep in the closing PR.
title: Pool renders under load: the spawn-rides-the-declared-clock flake is a CLASS
